title: Block Factory's Biomes
description: 🌳 This Biomes Add-on adds 3 brand-new biomes filled with unique animals, plants, blocks, and fully custom world generation!
body: [![Addon](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1746/1/hero-biomes-png.png)](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/block-factory/biomes-add--on/a995a919-46ca-4ade-a1c9-b634f98b7a72) Block Factory's Biomes adds 5 brand-new vanilla+ biomes, packed with unique animals, plants, blocks and fully custom world generation. ## 📋 About Block Factory's Biomes expands your world with 5 brand-new biomes that feel right at home next to vanilla Minecraft. Each one has its own atmosphere, wildlife and vegetation, woven into the world through fully custom generation, so exploration always has something fresh waiting over the next hill. Built vanilla+: more variety and detail, none of the base-game feel lost. ## 🌳 What's Inside 5 brand-new biomes - each with its own mood, palette and landscape Unique wildlife - new animals that roam and bring every biome to life New flora - fresh trees, plants and flowers to discover, harvest and build with Custom blocks - biome-specific blocks for decorating and collecting Fully custom world generation - natural terrain that blends seamlessly into existing worlds ## 🧭 Built Vanilla+ Every biome is crafted to match Minecraft's art style, so the new lands feel like they were always meant to be there - no clashing textures, no clutter, just more world to explore. ## 🚀 Supported Versions 1.21.1 - \[NeoForge\] 1.20.1 - \[forge\]
